# `anim-clip` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "anim-clip" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/anim-clip/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | required | Clip id (style bible §15.1), e.g. "anim-knight-sword-light-1". |
| `notes` | string | required | What the clip shows and where it comes from. |
| `rig` | ref → anim-graph | required | The rig (animation graph) whose skeleton the clip animates. |
| `duration` | number > 0 | required | Clip length, seconds. |
| `loop` | boolean | `false` | Loops (locomotion) or plays once and holds. |
| `additive` | boolean | `false` | Rotations are offsets added on top of lower layers (hit reactions). |
| `tracks` | map of string → list of object (at least 1) | required | Rotation keys per bone name; bones without a track keep their rest rotation. |
| `tracks.<key>[].t` | number ≥ 0 | required | Seconds from the clip start. |
| `tracks.<key>[].rot` | list of any (at least 3) | required | Local rotation from the rest pose, Euler degrees [x, y, z] (XYZ order). |
| `root` | list of object | — | Root translation found in the source clip. Never applied (clips play in place); kept as a velocity reference. |
| `root[].t` | number ≥ 0 | required | Seconds from the clip start. |
| `root[].pos` | list of any (at least 3) | required | Root translation in the source clip, metres. |
| `markers` | list of object | `[]` | Alignment markers; the first hit marker is warped onto the move’s first active tick. |
| `markers[].kind` | `"footstep"` \| `"hit"` \| `"release"` \| `"cast"` | required | footstep, hit, release or cast. |
| `markers[].t` | number ≥ 0 | required | Seconds from the clip start. |
